gaps.sentence: The box was heavy enough ___ two people.
gaps.explanation: adjective + enough + to-infinitive: heavy enough to need.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.

gaps.explanation: pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

gaps.sentence: I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: We managed ___ everyone before the storm hit.
I can't stand ___ kept waiting when I have an appointment.
gaps.explanation: 'Can't stand' takes a gerund; the passive gerund is 'being kept'.

gaps.sentence: When I was a student, I used ___ in shared flats.
gaps.explanation: used TO + infinitive = past habit/state: used to live. (Compare: be used to living.)
